subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds words with sounds learnt; groups common words into sound families (hot, hop, hob)

show.line: Word families! Hot, pot, dot all end in ot. Hop, top, mop all end in op.

rounds.prompt: Listen. h, o, t. What word is it?
Listen. m, o, p. Tap the word.
Change the h in hot to p. What word do you make?
Which word is in the ot family?
Which family? ot or op? Sort the words.

hints: Listen to the end. ot or op?
Keep the end the same. Change only the first sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will put mop in a family.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Mop goes with hot and pot!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Mop ends in op. It goes with hop and top.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen to the end. Mop, hop, top. The op family!

parent_line: Can build and sort words in the ot and op families.
